newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: National Bank NZ sells Lloyds Bank NZA to ABN AMRO.
newsitem.headline: National Bank NZ sells Lloyds Bank NZA to ABN AMRO.

text.p: National Bank of New Zealand Ltd on Monday said it had sold its wholly-owned subsidiary Lloyds Bank NZA Ltd to ABN AMRO Australia Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of ABN AMRO N.V. of the Netherlands.
The sale is conditional on regulatory approvals and is expected to be concluded on January 2. No sale price was disclosed.
Lloyds Bank NZA (LBNZA) operates mainly in wholesale treasury markets in Australia.

National Bank Chief Executive Sir John Anderson said the decision to sell had been reached after an assessment that LBNZA's growth had reached a point where additional value could only be achieved through participation in a wider range of wholesale activities.

Anderson said the sale also reflected National Bank's desire to concentrate its capital and resources within the New Zealand market, where it has strong franchises within both retail and wholesale markets.
National Bank is a unit of Lloyds TSB Group Plc.
